claims: The USA will face the Dominican Republic in a 2026 World Baseball Classic semifinal on Sunday, March 15, at 8 p.m. ET in Miami.
The Dominican Republic defeated Korea 10-0 in the quarterfinal.
Paul Skenes (USA) vs. Luis Severino (DR) is the expected pitching matchup, per FOX Sports.
The Dominican Republic hit a record-tying 14 home runs in the tournament.
The U.S. had a loss to Italy in pool play.
The USA and the Dominican Republic last met in the 2017 WBC.
The USA defeated the Dominican Republic in the second round of the 2017 WBC, reports USA Today.
The game is scheduled to air on FS1, notes MLB.com.
